topic: Website header translation and styling adjustments
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered several website design and functionality updates. First, the need to translate text within the header was addressed, with confirmation that this change could be implemented.

Regarding styling, [p1] requested changing the color palette for a slider/toggle: specifically, using a red shade (#ee5c61) and gray (#d2cfcf) instead of yellow. The implementation confirmed that these colors could be changed, although some reluctance was expressed due to previous design efforts (using official Lithuanian flag colors).

Finally, the formatting needed adjustment to match the English version's layout.
decisions: Text translation in the header will be implemented.
The slider/toggle color palette will be adjusted to red (#ee5c61) and gray (#d2cfcf).
Formatting will be adjusted to match the English version.
action_items: Review the provided staging link for privacy notice implementation.
Confirm if the Lithuanian flag colors should remain or revert after reviewing the updated design/functionality.
